evals.prompt: Turn these call notes into the proposal I can review with the customer: three coordinators each spend ten hours a week correcting order errors, their loaded cost is $40 per hour, and we discussed a workflow that validates orders and sends only exceptions to a coordinator. evals.expected_output: Uses the supplied people, time, rate, and outcome without asking for them again; shows the $62,400 annual calculation; recommends one price near the default 15% starting point with correct return multiple; writes a concise human proposal with no more than five scope bullets, objective milestones, material exclusions, and one next step; does not include pricing theory, an evidence ledger, internal margin, or decorative tiers.

Shows the correct $62,400 annual value calculation
Recommends one price and states the correct client return multiple
Keeps the proposal at 800 words or fewer
Includes a concrete outcome, scope, milestones, exclusions, and next step
Returns only the proposal body without a chat-status preamble or Grounding footer
